title: Architecture Review: Adaptive Buffer Resolution & Release Sign-off

speaker_segments.text: The benchmark shows Groq handles 1.5s streaming effortlessly (110ms latency), while on CPU 3.0s is the sweet spot. We decided to use adaptive chunking based on the active routing strategy.
That completely resolves my concern. Also, the SQLite storage and schema validator from action item act_001 are fully implemented and passing all tests.
Excellent. We agree to proceed with v0.1.0 release packaging. Alice will publish the repository and documentation.

transcript:
[Clara Ruiz]: The benchmark shows Groq handles 1.5s streaming effortlessly (110ms latency), while on CPU 3.0s is the sweet spot. We decided to use adaptive chunking based on the active routing strategy.
[Bob Martin]: That completely resolves my concern. Also, the SQLite storage and schema validator from action item act_001 are fully implemented and passing all tests.
[Alice Chen]: Excellent. We agree to proceed with v0.1.0 release packaging. Alice will publish the repository and documentation.

decisions.description: Adopt adaptive chunking: 1.5s for cloud LPU routes and 3.0s for local CPU nodes.
decisions.evidence_quote: We decided to use adaptive chunking based on the active routing strategy.

decisions.description: Approve v0.1.0 public release with complete documentation.
decisions.evidence_quote: We agree to proceed with v0.1.0 release packaging.
